titulo_da: Hun spurgte, om jeg havde tid
titulo_es: He asked if he had time.

texto: To tell a question of whether or not you use **spurgte om** (asked if) + subordinate order: **Hun spurgte, om jeg havde tid.** = asked if you had time.
No investment: do not put the verb before the subject, as in the direct question («Har du tid?»).
With **hvor** (where), **hvornår** (when) or **hvad** (what), the same rule: **Han spurgte, hvor jeg boede.** = He asked where he lived.
The verb changes time as in indirect style: «bor» → «boede».

filas: Hun spurgte, om jeg havde tid.
